answer: Nobody is waved through free: a fare of $38 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the delta never covers it twice. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. The manifest lists a name once it holds Dyehousebound dye worker cloth writ, and a writ dye workers sign after dye works checks is the entry the clerk looks for. anchor is written on the receipt. One vine, one entry.
